ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-to-mid intensity grey pixels with localized dark streaks; lacks high-intensity white patches; overall low global contrast ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dark diagonal linear streaks on both lobes; concentrated dark pixels along the trailing edges; irregular grey mottling around the medial notch and central fluke areas.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped notch with an approximate angle of 110-120 degrees and deep indentation into the fluke geometry.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Frequent irregular serrations along the trailing edge; pixel amplitude variations of 4-12 pixels; serrations are most distinct on the distal portions of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep near the medial notch transitioning to a convex curve towards the distal tips; left distal tip sweep partially constrained by the image frame.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast cluster of circular white-on-dark pixel groups located at the far right distal tip; smaller, isolated dark circular spots present on the left lobe's medial surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Prominent dark linear disruptions (rake marks); three long diagonal marks on the left lobe; multiple shorter vertical/diagonal streaks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on the right distal tip and distinct rake marks across the visible ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive parallel linear 'rake' scars likely from orca interaction, covering significant portions of both lobes.
